channel.title: RDWAN Tech — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Boost Your Home Surround Sound With These Simple Adjustments
item.description: Unlock the full potential of your home theater system without buying new gear by adjusting room acoustics, speaker placement, and calibration settings.

item.title: AI Industry Divided Over Future of Regulatory Frameworks
item.description: Tech leaders clash over AI safety proposals as the Trump administration labels industry-led regulation efforts a hoax amidst internal industry conflict.

item.title: How to Use Your Smartphone as a Smart TV Remote
item.description: Lost your remote? Learn how to turn your Android or iPhone into a functional smart TV controller using official apps, Wi-Fi, and infrared technology.

item.title: Thermacell Releases LIV 2.0 Smart Mosquito Repellent System
item.description: Thermacell has launched the LIV 2.0, an upgraded smart mosquito-control system designed to create a protected perimeter around outdoor living spaces.

item.title: US Navy CTO Outlines Strategic Tech Priorities for Investors
item.description: US Navy CTO Justin Fanelli details a shift toward co-investment with private capital, highlighting key priorities in AI, quantum, and autonomous systems.

item.title: Kojima Productions Rebuts Financial Difficulty Rumors
item.description: Kojima Productions has officially addressed reports regarding its financial health following the transition of its latest title, Physint, to Xbox.

item.title: AI Actress Tilly Norwood Implements Mandatory Face Scans
item.description: Viral AI actress Tilly Norwood now requires mandatory facial age verification and mood analysis for all callers before her service shuts down on September 27.

item.title: E Ink Tablets vs. iPad: Choosing the Right Display Technology
item.description: Discover the key differences between E Ink tablets and the iPad, focusing on display technology, battery efficiency, and ideal use cases for each device.

item.title: Texas Instruments: The Persistent Monopoly in Modern Education
item.description: An exploration of how Texas Instruments maintained a decades-long dominance in the educational calculator market, as discussed on Version History.

item.title: Stuck Pixels on Laptops: Causes and Potential Fixes
item.description: Discover why stuck pixels occur on laptop screens and explore safe, effective methods to potentially resolve the issue at home.

item.title: Valve Launches Steam Frame VR Headset Starting at $1,059
item.description: Valve has officially released its Steam Frame VR headset. Discover the latest tech news including new RPG titles and compact digital cameras.

item.title: Optical Drive Shortage Halts High-End CD Player Production by PS Audio and Naim
item.description: Supply chain collapse for optical drives forces PS Audio and Naim to stop production of premium CD players, doubling component costs amid rising physical media demand.

item.title: Trump’s Data Center Push Clashes With MAGA Base Opposition
item.description: Donald Trump’s support for AI data centers faces backlash from Republican voters and MAGA supporters who oppose expansion, per WIRED analysis.

item.title: Researchers Develop Whiskers for Tactile Drone Navigation
item.description: Engineers have created a lightweight whisker-based sensor system for sub-100 gram drones, enabling real-time navigation in dark or smoky conditions.

item.title: Major AI Chatbot Apps Now Compatible with Apple CarPlay
item.description: Drivers can now use AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, and more directly through Apple CarPlay following a recent iOS update.

item.title: How to Stream Free Movies and TV Shows on Your Smart TV
item.description: Discover effective ways to access free, ad-supported movies and television channels on your smart TV without needing a paid subscription.

item.title: How to Join a FaceTime Call from Android or Windows Devices
item.description: Learn how to join FaceTime calls on Android or Windows devices using a web browser, even without an Apple account or an Apple device of your own.

item.title: How to Set Up and Use Xbox Mode on Your Windows 11 PC
item.description: Learn how to activate and navigate Xbox mode on Windows 11 to create a controller-friendly, gaming-focused interface for your PC library.

item.title: Music History Podcast No Dogs in Space Returns for Season 4
item.description: After a two-year hiatus, hosts Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks bring back the music history podcast No Dogs in Space with a new season titled Punk 2.0.

item.title: Founders Shift Focus from Digital to In-Person Experiences
item.description: Tech founders like Brynn Putnam and Tristan Walker are pivoting toward physical, communal experiences to address rising social disconnection.

item.title: NHTSA and SAE Partner to Establish AV Safety Standards
item.description: The NHTSA has joined forces with SAE to create data-driven performance standards for autonomous vehicles, aiming to improve safety and foster innovation.

item.title: Android 17 QPR1 Updates Status Bar Icons on Pixel Devices
item.description: The stable release of Android 17 QPR1 introduces unexpected changes to mute and VPN status bar icons on Google Pixel smartphones.

item.title: Why Keeping Your Smart TV in Standby Mode Actually Helps
item.description: Smart TVs perform essential maintenance in standby mode. Discover why leaving your TV plugged in helps with software updates, pixel refreshes, and startup.

item.title: Understanding the Pros and Cons of Active Noise Cancellation
item.description: Active noise cancellation offers deep focus and hearing protection, but users should be aware of battery impacts and situational awareness risks.

item.title: How to Create Custom Stickers for iMessage and WhatsApp with ChatGPT
item.description: Learn how to use OpenAI's new sticker-specific workflow in ChatGPT to design and export custom stickers directly to iMessage and WhatsApp.

item.title: Prusa CORE One+ INDX Toolchanger Review: A Multicolor Shift
item.description: Prusa Research and Bondtech debut the INDX toolchanger for the CORE One+ platform, offering high-speed, low-waste multicolor 3D printing.

item.title: How to Properly Set Up and Optimize Your Sonos Speakers
item.description: Learn how to connect your Sonos smart speakers, troubleshoot common pairing issues, and optimize your audio quality using the official Sonos app.

item.title: AI Industry Debates Safety Pacts Amid Calls to Slow Down
item.description: Tech leaders are divided on the future of AI development as Anthropic and OpenAI propose safety frameworks while Nvidia pushes back against regulation.

item.title: California Enacts Fines for Influencers Hiding Political Ads
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed a new law, AB 1130, establishing financial penalties and potential criminal charges for undisclosed political ads.

item.title: Retroid Pocket Announces New Duo Lite Plus Handheld
item.description: Retroid Pocket has unveiled the Duo Lite Plus, a new mid-range gaming handheld, while offering free exchanges for recent Duo Lite customers.

item.title: How to Customize the Side Button on Your Samsung Galaxy Phone
item.description: Learn how to personalize your Samsung Galaxy side button for quick access to your favorite apps, voice assistants, and productivity shortcuts.

item.title: Meta Launches Muse AI Agent Amid Data Privacy Concerns
item.description: Meta’s new AI assistant, Muse, is gaining popularity for automating personal tasks, but critics warn the app prioritizes aggressive data collection.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation May Require 200GB Install
item.description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation is set to potentially set a new record for base game storage requirements, needing over 200 GB of drive space.

item.title: Microsoft Patents Ad-Injection System for Free-to-Play Games
item.description: Microsoft has filed a patent for a machine learning system that pauses gameplay to serve ads, granting users ad-free playtime in exchange for watching.

item.title: Massive 192GB GTA Leak Reveals Scrapped Content and Early Maps
item.description: A 192GB data leak has unveiled early GTA VI map concepts, canceled DLCs, and unused alternate endings for Grand Theft Auto V, surfacing years of development history.

item.title: Trump Proposes New 'AI Force' and Appointment of AI Czar
item.description: President Trump has announced plans to form an 'AI Force' led by an 'AI czar' to support industry growth, despite mounting calls for regulatory oversight.

item.title: How to Securely Wipe Your Old Laptop Before Disposal
item.description: Don't leave your personal data behind when upgrading your hardware. Follow these essential steps to back up, de-authorize, and securely wipe your laptop.

item.title: North Korean Hackers Target Job Applicants with Malware
item.description: Global security agencies warn that the North Korean 'WaterPlum' group is using fake job interviews to infect 30,000 devices and steal $10.7 million in crypto.

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and SpaceXAI Face Antitrust Lawsuit
item.description: A class-action lawsuit claims major AI firms violated antitrust laws by coordinating to slow development, alleging a self-serving strategy for market control.

item.title: FBI Director Claims 605% Increase in Agency AI Usage
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel reports a significant spike in AI adoption, citing increased efficiency in data triage and ongoing collaborations with tech leaders.
